summary: Completed backend API regression and public mobile UI testing. All executed backend tests passed; UI login, dashboard, student directory/search, and mobile overflow passed after allowing for API loading latency.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout after repeated failed attempts; auth playbook requirement is not implemented.
access_token cookie is issued with secure=False despite the public HTTPS deployment.

integration_issues.issue: Payment success says receipt ready, but no receipt view, print, download, or receipt endpoint/UI is implemented; Export ledger button is inert.
Mark renewal button is rendered without an action or backend integration.

action_items: Add brute-force protection/lockout after five failed logins.
Set secure=True for access_token in HTTPS deployment while preserving local compatibility as needed.
Implement printable/downloadable payment receipt flow and wire Export ledger.
Wire Mark renewal or remove the inactive control.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend has three React hook exhaustive-deps warnings caused by recreated load functions; stabilize callbacks or correct dependencies to avoid stale data behavior.
FeeRow performs one student API request per fee row, causing N+1 requests on the fees screen.
seed_data_creation: No new seed records; one existing attendance row was re-saved as PRESENT during UI/API verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested: https://music-academy-mgmt.preview.emergentagent.com. Initial UI assertions raced dashboard/student API loading; explicit waits resolved it. Backend suite has four passing tests.
rca of the issue: The receipt/export and renewal gaps are direct incomplete event wiring: controls render in App.js but have no onClick/navigation/API behavior. Brute-force protection is absent from the login handler, which only verifies credentials and sets a cookie.
